description: Realistic USGS NWIS site-service (seriesCatalogOutput=true&siteStatus=all) RDB rehearsal responses for the pre-G0 M1 remediation. `catalog_conformant` carries the provider's own `#` preamble — including the `# retrieved: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS ...` retrieval timestamp that every NWIS RDB body carries — and is metadata-only: the guard must classify it conformant. `catalog_with_observation_row` is the same body with a genuine per-timestamp observation block appended OUTSIDE the preamble: the guard must classify it value_bearing. Bodies are stored as `body_lines` (joined with LF) so the fixture stays canonical JSON and is covered by the DR-2 apparatus manifest.
provenance: Preamble/column shape transcribed from publicly documented NWIS RDB output (DOI-USGS/dataRetrieval RDB1Example.txt; hydrofunctions Data Catalog notebook) as cited in grimoires/loa/a2a/cycle-005/15-cycle-005-g0-decision-brief.md §1.3 M1. Values are SYNTHETIC — no provider was contacted; site 01646500 identity is transcribed from repository precedent (lab/test/acquisition-extract.spec.js), not from any response.
